title: Surreal Celestial Menagerie
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene features three cats (grey, black, and orange) sitting on a stone ledge beneath a large sleeping crescent moon with a face. In a lavender field below, mechanical elephants with glowing green book panels on their sides walk among red poppies while black cats leap between floating open books and glowing lilies. The sky is a stained-glass mosaic with a radiant sun, stars, and a ghostly luminous figure.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal fantasy painting of a dreamlike scene with three cats on a cliff ledge, one grey, one black with green pendant, one orange tabby. Below them in a vast field of lavender and poppies are ornate mechanical elephants carrying glowing green books on their sides. Floating open books, bonsai trees, and glowing white lilies drift through the air. A translucent glowing human figure stands among them. The sky is a colorful stained glass mosaic featuring a radiant sun and a large sleeping moon with a face, magical atmosphere, intricate details.
